experience.title: Freelance Developer
bullets: Integrated an AI-powered chatbot using the OpenAI API to assist workers during the platform registration process.
Used AI-assisted coding tools (GitHub Copilot) throughout development to accelerate iteration and debugging.
Developed and tested 15+ chatbot interaction scenarios to handle common registration questions and provide real-time responses.

projects.name: DocuMind (RAG Document Assistant)
projects.description: Built to understand how RAG systems work in practice, tackling the real problem of manually digging through long documents to find one answer.
bullets: Made it flexible — works across 5+ formats (PDF, DOCX, TXT, Markdown, URLs) with 3 AI providers to choose from.
Result: a working tool that pulls answers directly from any document, cutting search time from minutes to seconds.

projects.name: Cardio-Risk ML Model
projects.description: Built to get hands-on with the full ML pipeline — from raw data to a working prediction model.
bullets: Studied 1000+ clinical records (age, cholesterol, BP, lifestyle) for spotting heart disease risk early using data instead of guesswork.
Result: model flags risk with 88% accuracy, deployed as a web app for quick risk assessment.

projects.name: Expense Tracker
projects.description: Built a personal expense-tracking tool to solve a real problem: manually reviewing bank statements was slow and easy to lose track of.
bullets: Used it to log and analyze 1000+ transactions/month, surfacing spending patterns through visual summaries.
Result: helped cut recurring/avoidable expenses by 15% by making overspending categories visible at a glance.
